description: Test Set 2 for Legal Aid AI. Mixed real-world and synthetic evaluation questions, paraphrased into natural everyday English/Hinglish and fully anonymised. 36 cases: 10 consumer, 10 cyber, 9 Delhi tenancy, 7 constitutional/public-authority (RTI or legal aid). 'source_url' points to a verified, individually checkable real source for real-world cases; synthetic cases are explicitly labelled 'synthetic' and were written to fill out domain/scenario coverage, not derived from any external report. No case in this file uses an invented or unverified URL.

cases.question: my earbuds broke within warranty, company says test report shows no fault and now saying only 3 replacements allowed in 120 days which was never written anywhere when i bought it. can they just make up a new rule like this
cases.notes: real-world; paraphrased from a published case write-up (names changed in original article to Arjun Sharma/SonicWave/AuraPods, further anonymised here); not a forum post
